prompt: Illustrate a cutaway diagram of a small missile in flight, its nose cone opened to reveal a compact circuit board labeled "Jetson-class edge AI chip," directly wired to a small camera lens at the tip; around the missile, faint dotted lines show a rejected alternate path — a signal arcing up to a distant satellite and down to a data center building, crossed out with an "X" and stamped "too slow / no connection" — contrasting with a solid short arrow looping from the camera lens straight into the chip and back out to the missile's steering fins, labeled "instant, on-device decision"; beside the missile, smaller inset icons of a drone, a security camera, a smartphone, and a self-driving car all point to the same identical chip with the caption "same chip, everyday uses," while a faint factory silhouette in the background releases a stream of identical chips into both the civilian icons and the missile, visually showing how one mass-produced, low-power component quietly flows from ordinary gadgets into autonomous weapons without any special checkpoint stopping it.
